command:
set -eu
test -f /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko
test ! -L /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko
test "$(wc -c < /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko)" = 1015070
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
test "$(sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = 1a312cf33a0ca67c170b9dc73a56a58fa03a0f05bbfb6277a72740dd8e7328a4
echo "CHUNK_START_UPTIME=$(cut -d ' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)"
echo DATA_BEGIN
dd if=/lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko bs=32768 skip=8 count=1 2>/dev/null | base64
echo DATA_END
test "$(sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/sdp_pqe_frc.ko | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = 1a312cf33a0ca67c170b9dc73a56a58fa03a0f05bbfb6277a72740dd8e7328a4
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
echo "CHUNK_END_UPTIME=$(cut -d ' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)"
echo CHUNK_COMPLETE
